notes: NI Alicia's Keys ΓÇö Alicia Keys' personal Yamaha C3 Neo grand piano, multi-sampled at 16 velocity layers. Runs in Kontakt. CC 11 (Expression) is the most useful real-time control for dynamics. NKS Quick Controls 1-8 are pre-assigned to the most useful parameters.

Expression.description: Expression ΓÇö controls dynamics/velocity response in real time (essential for expressive playing)

Soft Pedal.description: Una corda (soft pedal) ΓÇö shifts to softer samples

Quick Control 1.description: Close Mic Level ΓÇö direct pickup microphone (bright, present)

Quick Control 2.description: Room Mic Level ΓÇö ambient room microphone (natural, open)

Quick Control 3.description: Sustain Resonance ΓÇö sympathetic string resonance when sustain pedal held

Quick Control 4.description: Release Noise ΓÇö key-up/hammer noise level (adds realism)

Quick Control 5.description: Reverb Mix ΓÇö built-in reverb amount

Quick Control 8.description: Stereo Width ΓÇö microphone stereo image width
